{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Santan Expansion Lateral''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from El Paso South System Line 2000 interconnect, Arizona to Santan power plant, Gilbert, Arizona.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=57007|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''El Paso Natural Gas Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=57007|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''342,500 Dth/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=57007|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''36 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2004<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
